patch_description:
Replace the current double-block structure (which redundantly repeats the ansatz with the same parameters, unnecessarily doubling depth to 65) with a single-block ansatz that splits the shared RZ parameter into independent pre- and post-entanglement phases. This maintains the proven accuracy while:

1. Reducing depth from 65 back to 35 (eliminating the redundant second block)
2. Increasing learnable parameters from 14 to 15 (minimal overhead, still highly parameter-efficient)
3. Granting independent tuning of pre-entanglement and post-entanglement phase shifts, which can improve model expressiveness without increasing gate count

This directly addresses parameter economy by removing redundancy while introducing meaningful expressiveness through phase differentiation.
